scope_evidence: The official download page places HowNet core data and the API under the OpenHowNet download section and states that OpenHowNet uses the MIT license.
The official repository identifies itself as Core Data of HowNet and OpenHowNet Python API and asks users of OpenHowNet data or API to cite the project paper.
required_citations: Fanchao Qi, Chenghao Yang, Zhiyuan Liu, Qiang Dong, Maosong Sun, Zhendong Dong. OpenHowNet: An Open Sememe-based Lexical Knowledge Base. 2019.
Zhendong Dong and Qiang Dong. HowNet-a hybrid language and knowledge resource. 2003.
reason: Official OpenHowNet download and repository pages apply MIT licensing to the project containing both core data and API; preserve attribution and citations.
